capability.name: Tesorería
intents: abrir cerrar o arquear una caja
preparar revisar o ejecutar una corrida de pagos
importar y conciliar un extracto bancario
explicar dinero en tránsito o una diferencia de conciliación

dependencies: tenant legal entity branch and currency context
house bank and bank account master
posting behavior and semantic clearing accounts
restrictions: AR and AP own obligations while Treasury owns movement and settlement of money
money reaches a bank account through deposit settlement or reconciliation rather than direct receipt posting
every movement is tenant scoped idempotent and attributable
payment proposal approval execution and bank acknowledgment are distinct states
provider credentials and signing authority never leave their protected boundary
matching never destroys an unmatched residual or alters a bank statement fact
country formats routing and accounting differences are governed configuration

deterministic: inspect cash payment deposit settlement statement and reconciliation state
trace obligation to movement to clearing to bank to Ledger
explain expected counted deposited and reconciled differences
score reconciliation candidates without executing a match
poDecision: approve treasury ADR and service boundary
approve payment providers instruments and countries
approve write-off tolerance and settlement policy
approve bank connectivity and payment execution scope
reviewerGate: provider settlement gross fee refund and net identity
forbiddenWithoutApproval: close or reopen a reconciled period

retrieval.provenance: Treasury capability derived from proposed UBP ADR-0024 and partial code anchors at pinned UBP revision ebf1c845bdf917d821f3182bff0cbe04c21d2c8e. The central Treasury service and full cash-to-bank cycle remain unimplemented.
